batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c K Rabada b AR Patel

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b AR Patel

batting.name: J Yadav
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b R Ashwin

batting.name: RR Pant

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b JJ Bumrah

balls.text: finishes with six down the ground! Ashwin tosses this up a touch, and Krunal is waiting for it, deep inside the crease. Just sashays half a step down the wicket and clobbers him straight down the ground. Just clears the rope in the end, and Mumbai get the target up to 130!
closer to the stumps. Krunal looks for the sweep, but fails to make contact. Just flicks the pad, and Pant does well to get his body behind it
length, around off, and he slaps it hard to long off. Refuses the single on offer
length, drops it by his feet and takes a quick single. Ashwin gets to the ball but cannot pick it up in one action to have a shy at the stumps to run new man Bumrah out
slower, around off, and he looks to go inside out, but cannot clear Steven Smith at extra cover. Just on the edge of the circle, and has to time his jump to perfection
length, and he has gone across the line, but gets the right distance. Way over long on
fullish, and he goes across the line towards midwicket, who's quite deep in the ring. Easy single
length, and he has rifled this right back down the ground. Perhaps just not full enough to prevent new man Jayant Yadav from using the depth of the crease
second in the over! Fullish, but not quite the yorker. A bit of in dipping movement in at 140 kph, and NCN goes for the big heave down the ground, but it goes on to strike timber behind him
looks for the full ball again, but just down the leg side. Krunal gets it to short fine leg, but they sneak a single
looks for the yorker again to Nathan Coulter-Nile, who is able to take it on the full and push it to long-on

got 'im! Avesh Khan with a ball that would have made Waqar Younis in his prime proud. A hint of inswing with a yorker, and Hardik has already moved across his stumps hoping to open up options either side of the wicket. But he's too late with his bat as it slips through his legs and hits the base of leg stump
back of the hand, outside off. Krunal swings, Krunal misses
short again, and he looks to pull this to the same region. A bit of extra pace, and that makes him place this along the ground to deep midwicket
full, outside off, and he fails to make contact with this
short, around the right shoulder, and he has pulled this in front of square. A chase on between the ball and the man at deep midwicket, and the ball wins
yorker, absolutely creamed back at the bowler, and he calmly holds it
slower ball, lofted down the ground. A couple of bounces, and through for four. The length was full, and that helped Hardik
slower ball, around off, and he drives this firmly towards long on
full toss, bashed away towards deep midwicket. The man at wide long on has a bit of running to do, and that allows them to pinch two
Krunal picks up a slower ball, short in length, and pulls it just behind square. Not entirely in control, but did well to leave it as late as possible. Placed it to the right of fine leg
yorker length, driven firmly back towards long off
length, wide outside off, and he has slashed this away towards deep point. Sweeper cover runs to his left and keeps it down to two
yorker, pace up, and he drives it to long on
slower yorker, outside off, and he drives this towards sweeper cover
length, a bit of swing away from Krunal again, and he is beaten for a second ball in a row
ooh, what a ball! Perhaps a change up in pace, as it pitches around off, and moves further away. Krunal doesn't quite know what to do. Opens up hoping to play it through the leg side, but is beaten
short, outside off, and he slaps this away with a horizontal bat towards long-on
length, around off, and he drives hard, but straight to cover
back of a length, off cutter, and he slashes that away to point
full, down the legside, and moving further away. Surprisingly, not called a wide. Perhaps took a little bit of the pad, or just some welcome leniency for the bowler?
slower again, around off, driven but with the inside edge, towards short midwicket
short, a change of place again. Krunal goes for the pull, but cannot make any connection
fuller, pace up, driven to cover inside the circle

back of the hand slower ball. Krunal drives it firmly back, but strikes the stumps at the other end. Just loops off his bat, and goes close to Nortje, but he didn't get his fingers to that. Otherwise, Hardik would have been run out!
looks for the yorker. Overcooks it a touch, but it goes at good pace. Krunal defends. Not far off from a no-ball

chopped on! May have been a slight change in pace, but the length makes the difference. Back of a length, outside off, and Pollard will be disappointed. He looks for the nurdle down to third, but is only able to redirect it on to the base of his stumps. Mumbai in freefall mode
length, pushed towards the man inside the ring at point
fired in again, around the pads, and he works it away to Hetmyer at midwicket
fired quick, but down the leg side
wide of the crease, and he works it with the incoming slant towards deep midwicket
fuller, around leg, and worked off his legs towards wide long-on
length, around off, driven to long-off
flatter, around off, and he pulls this away towards the longer boundary on the onside, close to deep midwicket
starts by spraying it down leg. Went wide of the crease, looking to perhaps get it to straighten after pitching
length, presses forward to defend

induces the error from Tiwary! Tossed up a touch more, and outside off. Tiwary winds up to go across the line, and ends up top-edging it. Pant calls, and calmly collects it right in front of where Axar follows through. Tiwary briskly walks off
slants in, and he works this towards deep midwicket
length, pushed back to the bowler
another yorker, worked away towards deep midwicket
fires in a yorker, but just down the leg side. Will have to go again
flat, around off, and he punches it off the back foot towards long on
back of a length, around off. He taps it towards point and takes a quick single
this will be wide down the leg side. Was looking for a change of pace, the off-cutter, but just started on leg stump and went further down
yorker, and dug out towards short midwicket. The lone man inside the circle on the onside
fuller, straighter, and worked away towards deep midwicket for a single
fuller length, driven to wide cover. No run again
length, across him, and he defends
length, driven to point off the back foot
flatter, and worked away towards deep midwicket
lofted, straight down the ground. Terrific bit of timing. Just a couple of bounces and through to the fence
flatter, a touch wide of off, and he looks to slog across the line. The ball sneaks under the bat

Rabada pouches a comfortable catch at long on! Surya will be disappointed, because this was a full toss. Was looking to clear Rabada at long-on, but just got it off the toe-end. The big South African moved swiftly forward and took it low down to extinguish what had been an innings of some promise
flicked from middle and leg towards deep midwicket
right up in the blockhole, dug out towards point for a quick single
works this down to long-on
has he found the man? Ah, no. Thought he mistimed it but just manages to clear this over deep midwicket. Goes all the way.
skiddy bouncer, beaten as he shapes to hook that out of the park
squeezed to third man
lunges forward and drives to cover
worked to deep midwicket
eased with the spin to long-off
eased down to long-on
lofted but ends up hitting it one bounce to Avesh at sweeper cover. Good effort running in from the deep, thought about the catch briefly but pulled out of it
crisply driven to deep cover
drives this low full toss to long-off
cut away but can't pierce point
punched to sweeper cover
superbly done! Gets a long way across and uses Ashwin's pace to sweep this full ball wide of short fine leg
drifting into the pads, tucked wide of midwicket for a quick single
worked to midwicket at the edge of the ring
slog-swept over the long boundary!  In fact just short, one bounce. Generously tossed up outside off, SKY was down on one knee as he went after that one, struck it superbly.
shortish on middle and leg, punched to long-on
fullish on the pqds, tucked to deep midwicket
driven with the spin to wide long-off
chops this to point
gets well forward and bunts it wide of cover to get off the mark

sliced to point! Axar has beaten QDK in the air. This was beautifully tossed up a touch wide, de Kock had to reach out for this but the ball dipped on him as he went through with the stroke. Nortje with a simple catch
works this into the gap at deep midwicket, called for two and made it comfortably
squeezes this fullish delivery to square third man
beaten as he has a hoick at this slower delivery angling away, more frustration
mistimes this full toss straight to mid-off
no timing as he looks to play the half-pull/scoop, lobs in the air but lands short of short fine
takes pace off, QDK is looking to scoop but has to readjust, gets a thick inside edge onto the pad as the ball rolls to square leg
stands tall and punches this length ball to mid-on
can't pierce the gap at cover as he punches this.
cracking off-drive but the ball pulls up, Smith slides around to keep it to a couple
right into the blockhole, kept out
looks to scoop again as Rabada goes full on middle, QDK ends up toe-ending this into the gap at square leg
firm push to cover
scooped over short fine! Rabada slants it across, but QDK is quicker in getting across, uses his fast hands to pick this up and over
chipped it back but lands short of mid-off
beaten for pace by this length ball that beats his attempted nudge into the leg side, hit on the box
runs this down to square third man
hint of width, he punches this straight to cover point
gets a bottom-edge that rolls back to the keeper as he defends forward
length ball angling in towards off, defended
driven straight to extra cover
works this down to long-on for an easy single
swept uppishly and he clears the ropes! Brave from Surya, gets outside the line to eliminate the lbw and swats him over deep square leg
works this with the spin but can't beat short fine
pushes it down to long-off as he gets well forward
punches this down to long-on
whipped away deliciously into the gap at midwicket. Strong wrists, strong bottomhand
taken at third man! Avesh has Rohit playing a pull shot that he's late on - yes, he's beaten for pace - and ends up slicing it to third man. Rabada takes an easy catch.
gets a thick inside edge onto the body as he's hustled for pace. Superb bowling from Avesh. This one was banged into the pitch
has a flay at this length ball outside off, but Avesh ends up bowling it wider than he would've hopes for. Rohit beaten, wide called.
sways out of the way of this short ball outside off
tucks him up with a length ball angling into middle, defended to midwicket
leading edge, rolls to mid-off. That was bowled at 135.2kph
slants a length ball across, solidly defended
goes over the top, but one bounce to deep square. Looked like Rohit wanted to go over midwicket, but this one came off a thickish inside edge
whipped off his hip into the gap at deep square
whips this length delivery from off to midwicket
length, and he defends just by the wicket
on the pads, and worked away with typical Rohit class through the square leg region

Ashwin goes across the line, and all the way! A slog sweep a la Steve Waugh, and then a little scream in delight. He was partly to blame for the way that Mumbai had posted 129 in the first place, but boy has he made up with the bat in a tense chase
opens his stance up, and slices this just over the inside circle. Mid off is quite wide, and is able to stop it to his left
game of cat-and-mouse! Iyer shuffles across, and Boult fires it in down the leg side. Dropped towards deep square leg

change of pace, as he looks to play this towards cover after backing away. There's a shy at the non-striker's end, and it has gone for two overthrows! Rohit Sharma goes for the throw, and he could have actually taken Ashwin's wicket, but there was just not enough backing up
fullish, worked away towards midwicket. Hardik Pandya is able to half-stop it but can't prevent the single

that's plain lucky for Ashwin! It's a length ball, and Ashwin looks to go for the drive down the ground with a couple of steps down the ground. Gets an outside edge, and it goes over point. Saurabh Tiwary goes from third man and gets a boot on it. Seems to have done some damage to himself. Lying by the boundary, clutching his leg
into the pitch, around off, pulled away, but stopped at midwicket

length, and he hangs back in the crease and latches on to a ball from just around off. A little shuffle opens up the leg side, and he clumps this across the line towards mid-wicket. Good enough to fetch four
full toss, in looking for the yorker. Heading for leg stump, but he can drive it down to long on
angled in, around off, and he drives this through the region to the left of midwicket towards wide long on
length, slapped through covers to the man in the deep
length, close to him, and he runs it down to third man for the single
length, around off, comes back in with the angle. Keeps a touch low, but Iyer defends
fullish, around off. He looks for the glide down towards third man, but misses
short, into him, and he drives on the up. Fielded at wide cover
length, angles in, driven to long on
slower ball, holds up in the pitch, and Iyer hangs back, and whacks it through the vacant deep midwicket region
short, worked towards midwicket. No runs this time
fullish, played towards deep mid. There was a slight misfield at midwicket, but that hasn't cost them extra runs
yorker, dug out towards long on. Good bit of cricket all around, as they complete a quick run
works across his stumps, and works it with the angle towards deep square leg
length, plays a gorgeous, lofted extra cover drive. Goes on a couple of bounces to the sweeper out in the deep
worked away through the onside towards deep midwicket
length, driven to cover. They look for the single, but Ashwin has to quickly turn back
looks for the slower, scrambled seam ball, but gets it all wrong. Way wide of the tramlines on the offside
length, from around the wicket. Tapped towards point. A shy at the stumps, but he's well in when it hits. And it also drops right by the stumps
short, and goes off his shoulder, and possibly bit of his helmet, as he shapes to hook this. Ran away towards third man. Yes, close to the badge on his helmet, in fact!
slower ball, around off, driven towards long on
length, around off, and he has worked himself across the crease to access the onside. Played towards wide long on for a single
length, into him, and he stands tall to punch this towards square leg
slower ball, driven wide of cover for a quick single. They are able to pinch an overthrow, thanks to the shy at the non-striker's end
length, jags back in from just around off and middle, and strikes him high on the pad
length, outside off, and he has pierced the gap between point and wide cover. No wicket maiden for Boom
length, hits him high on the bat. Just outside off, and he drives it to cover
length, outside off. Looks for the nurdle down to third man, but is beaten by the slower one
length, defended towards extra cover
length, taps it to point, one of the fielders closing in to save the single
length, stopped on him, and he looks to work it towards the onside. Loops away towards short cover. Gratefully accepted. Change of pace does the trick again
fullish, driven towards long off
short of a length, and he goes back and pulls this ferociously through midwicket. Nobody in the deep, and that's four more
length, smashed down the ground. Pollard gets to it at long-off, and saves two
fullish, down the ground towards long on
works it off his pads this time, a much straighter ball. Towards deep backward square
length, width on offer, and he goes inside out through the extra cover region. There's just a deep point in place, and it goes into the fence after a couple of bounces
length, worked towards third man with a little open face of the bat
goes straightaway for the yorker. Worked with the angle towards deep square leg. They come through for two. QdK whips the bails off, but he has made it comfortably

length, cutter, and he is struck in front of the pads as he looks to play across the line. Given out leg before, and he reviews. Nothing wrong with the impact, and also hit him right in front of the stumps, as he got stuck in the crease. Not inside edge. Umpire's call, and he's Delhi's fifth wicket to fall, as Mumbai continue to claw back
cutter, and he runs this down towards third man
fuller length, on pace, and angles into him. Worked towards deep midwicket
length, a slower ball, and he shuffles across to work it towards deep square leg
down the wicket and chips this over mid off. Got a lot of height on this, and just a bounce in towards the boundary
worked with the angle from around the wicket towards midwicket
worked with the incoming slant towards fine leg
donkey-drop, but down the leg side. Another wide
fuller, wider, and he is drawn into a drive. Uppish, but just to the left of Coulter-Nile at point
length, around off, driven firmly, but straight to wide cover inside the circle
full, but down the leg side. Axar lets it pass
fullish, driven towards long on
flatter one on middle and leg, tucks this wide of midwicket
fires in a length ball across the left-hander, tucks it into the gap at midwicket
eased down to long-off as they jog the single
punches back, good stop by Krunal off his own bowling
punches this down to long-on
whips this to deep midwicket
works this down to long-on
sharp turn as he shortens his length, Iyer defends
gets a leading edge that rolls to cover as he tries and works it to the leg side
fires this down leg, Iyer beaten as he tries to tickle it fine Wide called
punches this to wide long-off
he's holed out to long-on! Pant backed away to slog but Jayant tossed it up nicely, Pant had to literally muscle this away and swung hard but just didn't get timing or power. Simple catch.
shortish outside off, cut away to deep point
struck on the pad as Pant tries to reverse-whatever. Can't call it a scoop, definitely not a sweep, neither was it a ramp. This yorker length delivery was sliding down, hit him on the boot.
pulls this from outside off to long leg
backs away and pull this short ball to deep midwicket
slaps this straight to point
steps out to slap this up and over, but NCN bowls a cutter into the pitch, Pant gets a thick bottom edge to the keeper.
flicked to deep square leg
fired full, Pant saved by an under-edge. Got into a tangle as he tried to reverse sweep.
walks across to flick, but turns this uppishly, short of Jayant on his followthrough
rocks back and pulls into the gap at deep midwicket
lunges forward and smothers this
flicked to deep midwicket
walks across and ramps him over the keeper's head, didn't have much pace to work with. Lot of risk for just two runs
that's been drilled down the ground! No one moved. Too full, Pant showed the full face of the bat to play that rocket drive. Tracer bullet stuff
bunts this to short third
he's swung this over midwicket, beats Krunal to the boundary. Bumrah with a length ball, Pant cleared his front leg and hammered that away
worked off his pads, into the gap at deep square. Sliding stop by Krunal to save a couple of runs
through him! Looks to work this into the leg side, the ball nips back in to beat the inside edge, through to the keeper
Iyer gets a thick inside edge onto the pad, the ball rolls into the off side and they take a quick single
looks to scoop this over backward square leg but NCN cleverly changed his pace, beaten
another mow across the line, gets a thick edge onto the boot
gets a thick under-edge that flies past leg stump, beats short fine leg for a streaky boundary. Wasn't all that short for a pull
length on off, pushed into the off side, looks for a single but is sent back
whips this length ball to deep square leg
got him! NCN gets Smith with one that keeps low. Smith shuffled across to work it leg side but played all around it. Capitals are in trouble or what?
whips this from outside off to pick the gap at midwicket
right on top of the bounce as he taps it to point
helped along to clear long leg!  Short, sat up nicely as Smith swivelled on the pull and simply let this slide on.
hits the hard length on off, Pant taps it into the covers for a quick single
whips this down to long leg
length outside off, pushed to point
he's clobbered this over the stands at deep midwicket! Saw the flight, in his hitting arc, and just couldn't resist.
steps out and turns this quicker delivery to midwicket

struck on the pad, is that gone? Not out says umpire Chaudhary. He rocked back to pull but missed it completely. Looked like it was sliding down. Mumbai review. Ball tracking comes back to say this would've smashed leg stump. Mumbai were seemingly reluctant to review that because de Kock too thought it may have been sliding down. Rohit went up for it eventually and what a good decision it turned out to be.
punches this straight to cover
drifting into the pads, worked to deep midwicket
this is a jaffa! Beats him on the outside straightaway. Smith plays for the arm-ball but this grips and turns

direct hit by Pollard, Dhawan is gone! He stepped out, Jayant shortened his length, Dhawan pushed it straight to mid-on and took off, but was beaten by Pollard's rocket throw at the non-striker's end. Comfortably short of the crease.
pushed to cover, wants a single but is sent back
fires this in to tuck Dhawan up, defended
glorious! Lofted inside-out over deep extra cover. Didn't get to the pitch but went through with the stroke and cleared the ropes effortlessly.
overpitched on the pads, Shaw flicks this uppishly, through Coulter-Nile at square leg
tossed up on off, driven down to long-off
slants one across, there's no swing this time and Shaw fearlessly punches him on the up through extra cover. Delightfully done
not much pace on the pitch, Prithvi shapes to cut but ends up toe-ending this back down the pitch.
angles one into middle, tucked to square leg
full and swinging away from off, driven to cover point
flicked beautifully off the pads, excellent stop at deep square by Krunal, who had to cover a lot of ground
hint of movement back in from length on off, defended back
